note: Demo rulebook. Section references were checked against the SHA documents saved in docs/sources. A rule is marked verified:true when its legal basis was read in those documents. Reference data (service catalogue, most tariff caps, facility registry) is illustrative, and each rule's note says what is not covered.

regulations_2024.document: Social Health Insurance Regulations, 2024 (Legal Notice No. 49 of 2024), Kenya Gazette Supplement No. 60 of 8 March 2024

phc_annexure.document: SHA Contract, Annexure B1-A: Primary Healthcare Fund Tariffs and Payment Rates

R1.name: Member eligibility
R1.condition: The patient is a registered member of the Social Health Insurance Fund, with active contributions on the date of service.
R1.quote: All benefits under the Act and these Regulations shall be paid where valid claims in respect of a beneficiary of the Social Health Insurance Fund are lodged and approved for payment by the Authority.
R1.note: The gazetted text requires registration. The wording about active contributions comes from the draft General Regulations 2023, so the contribution status must be confirmed by the facility on the SHA portal.

pass.active.en: Member is registered with active contributions on {date}.
pass.active.sw: Mwanachama amesajiliwa na michango yake iko hai tarehe {date}.

fail.inactive.en: Member's contributions are not active on {date}.
fail.inactive.sw: Michango ya mwanachama haiko hai tarehe {date}.

warn.unknown.en: Contribution status was not confirmed, so eligibility cannot be verified.
warn.unknown.sw: Hali ya michango haijathibitishwa, kwa hivyo ustahiki hauwezi kuthibitishwa.

confirm-contributions.en: Renew the member's contributions, then confirm them as active
confirm-contributions.sw: Fanya upya michango ya mwanachama kisha uthibitishe kuwa iko hai

verify-eligibility.en: Verify the member's eligibility on the SHA portal before submitting
verify-eligibility.sw: Thibitisha ustahiki wa mwanachama kwenye tovuti ya SHA kabla ya kuwasilisha

R2.name: Facility contract
R2.condition: Benefits are paid to an empanelled and contracted facility, and the facility's contract for the claimed fund covers the date of service.
R2.quote: The Authority may ... pay benefits to (a) an empanelled and contracted healthcare provider or health facility within or outside Kenya; and (b) any healthcare provider or health facility that has been licensed and certified to provide emergency services in accordance with the benefits package of the Emergency, Chronic and Critical Illness Fund.
R2.note: The registry of contracted facilities is synthetic. The emergency-licence route in 57(1)(b) is not modelled.

fail.not_contracted.sw: Kituo {facility} hakina mkataba wa {fund} unaohusu tarehe {date}.

warn.unknown_facility.en: Facility {facility} is not in the registry, so its contract could not be checked.
warn.unknown_facility.sw: Kituo {facility} hakipo kwenye sajili, kwa hivyo mkataba wake haukuweza kukaguliwa.

R3.name: Pre-authorisation
R3.condition: Specialised services need an approved pre-authorisation, except in an emergency.
R3.quote: A healthcare provider or health facility shall send an online pre-authorization request to the Authority for the specialized healthcare services as determined by the Authority ... Provided that pre-authorization shall not apply for emergency services.
R3.note: SHA decides which services are specialised, and that list was not in the documents. The services marked as needing pre-authorisation here are illustrative. Hakiki checks that a reference is present, not that it is valid.

pass.not_required.en: Service {service} does not require pre-authorisation under {fund}.
pass.not_required.sw: Huduma {service} haihitaji idhini ya awali chini ya {fund}.

pass.emergency_exempt.en: Pre-authorisation does not apply to emergency services.
pass.emergency_exempt.sw: Idhini ya awali haihusu huduma za dharura.

pass.attached.sw: Nambari ya idhini ya awali imeambatishwa kwa huduma {service}.

fail.missing.en: Service {service} requires pre-authorisation and none is attached.
fail.missing.sw: Huduma {service} inahitaji idhini ya awali na hakuna iliyoambatishwa.

skip.unknown_service.en: Not evaluated: service {service} is not in the rulebook.
skip.unknown_service.sw: Haikukaguliwa: huduma {service} haipo kwenye kitabu cha kanuni.

attach-preauth.sw: Ambatisha nambari ya idhini ya awali

R4.name: Benefit coverage
R4.condition: The service is part of the benefits package of the fund being claimed against.
R4.section: Regulation 7(3), Second Schedule (Primary Healthcare Fund package)
R4.quote: The Authority shall, using monies from the Primary Healthcare Fund, purchase from a health facility the primary healthcare services specified in the benefits package set out in the Second Schedule to these Regulations.
R4.note: The Second Schedule lists outpatient, inpatient and maternity services as PHC benefits. The service-by-fund list used here is a simplification.

pass.covered.en: Service {service} is in the {fund} benefit package.
pass.covered.sw: Huduma {service} ipo kwenye mfuko wa manufaa wa {fund}.

fail.not_covered.en: Service {service} is not in the {fund} benefit package.
fail.not_covered.sw: Huduma {service} haipo kwenye mfuko wa manufaa wa {fund}.

fail.unknown_service.en: Service code {service} is not in the rulebook, so coverage cannot be confirmed.
fail.unknown_service.sw: Msimbo wa huduma {service} haupo kwenye kitabu cha kanuni, kwa hivyo ufadhili hauwezi kuthibitishwa.

R5.name: Facility level
R5.condition: The facility's KEPH level is high enough to deliver the service under the claimed fund.
R5.section: Regulation 10(c)(ii) and the point of access in the Second Schedule
R5.quote: [The Social Health Insurance Fund shall be used to] pay for the provision of quality healthcare services to beneficiaries under the Act offered by empanelled and contracted ... level 4, 5 and 6 health facilities.
R5.note: Primary healthcare services are accessed at Levels 2 to 4, and the Social Health Insurance Fund pays Levels 4 to 6. Minimum levels for individual services beyond that are illustrative.

pass.level_ok.en: Facility level {level} meets the required level {required} for {fund}.
pass.level_ok.sw: Kiwango cha kituo {level} kinatosha kwa kiwango kinachohitajika {required} cha {fund}.

fail.level_low.en: Facility is Level {level} but {service} under {fund} requires Level {required} or higher.
fail.level_low.sw: Kituo ni Kiwango {level} lakini {service} chini ya {fund} inahitaji Kiwango {required} au zaidi.

skip.unknown_facility.en: Not evaluated: facility {facility} is not in the registry.

skip.unknown_service.en: Not evaluated: service {service} is not in the rulebook.
skip.unknown_service.sw: Haikukaguliwa: huduma {service} haipo kwenye kitabu cha kanuni.

skip.not_in_fund.en: Not evaluated: {service} is not offered under {fund}.

route-to-facility.en: Deliver the service at a Level {required}+ facility such as {target}
route-to-facility.sw: Toa huduma katika kituo cha Kiwango {required}+ kama {target}

R6.name: Tariff cap
R6.condition: The billed amount does not exceed the gazetted tariff for the service under the claimed fund.
R6.quote: Normal delivery and essential newborn care - KES 10,000. Caesarean section and essential newborn care - KES 30,000.
R6.note: Only the two Primary Healthcare Fund maternity rates were read from a published document. Every other cap is an illustrative placeholder, and the trace says so. Tariffs are set by the Social Health Insurance (Tariffs for Healthcare Services) Regulations, Legal Notice 56 of 2025 as amended by Legal Notice 78 of 2026, which were not available.

pass.within_cap.en: Billed KES {amount} is within the KES {cap} tariff.
pass.within_cap.sw: Kiasi kilichotozwa KES {amount} kiko ndani ya ushuru wa KES {cap}.

fail.over_cap.en: Billed KES {amount} exceeds the KES {cap} tariff.
fail.over_cap.sw: Kiasi kilichotozwa KES {amount} kinazidi ushuru wa KES {cap}.

skip.no_tariff.en: Not evaluated: no tariff exists for {service} under {fund}.
skip.no_tariff.sw: Haikukaguliwa: hakuna ushuru wa {service} chini ya {fund}.

reduce-amount.en: Reduce the billed amount to the KES {cap} tariff
reduce-amount.sw: Punguza kiasi kilichotozwa hadi ushuru wa KES {cap}

R7.name: Documentation
R7.condition: The claim carries the clinical details that Form 3 requires, so the claim can be adjudicated.
R7.quote: The claim ... shall contain information including (a) the Social Health Authority number of the patient; (b) the hospital registration number of the patient; (c) the name, date of birth, gender, address and contact details of the patient; (d) the clinical details of the patient; and (e) amount claimed.
R7.note: Hakiki checks that a diagnosis code is present as the clinical detail. It does not receive patient identity fields, by design.

pass.complete.en: A diagnosis code is recorded as the clinical detail.
pass.complete.sw: Msimbo wa utambuzi umerekodiwa kama maelezo ya kitabibu.

warn.no_diagnosis.en: No diagnosis code. Form 3 requires the clinical details of the patient.
warn.no_diagnosis.sw: Hakuna msimbo wa utambuzi. Fomu ya 3 inahitaji maelezo ya kitabibu ya mgonjwa.

R8.name: Duplicates and frequency
R8.condition: The claim is not a duplicate of an earlier claim and does not exceed the frequency limit for the service.
R8.section: Regulation 61(3) (non-compliant claims are not paid or are refunded)
R8.quote: Where the independent panel finds that ... the claim is not complaint, the healthcare provider or health facility shall not be paid for the claim.
R8.note: The regulations do not define duplicates or frequency limits. These checks follow standard claims-audit practice, and the limits are illustrative.

pass.unique.en: No earlier claim for the same patient, service and date.
pass.unique.sw: Hakuna dai la awali la mgonjwa, huduma na tarehe sawa.

pass.within_limits.en: Frequency for {service} is within the allowed limit.
pass.within_limits.sw: Mara za huduma {service} ziko ndani ya kikomo kinachoruhusiwa.

fail.duplicate.en: Same patient, service and date as earlier claim {other}.
fail.duplicate.sw: Mgonjwa, huduma na tarehe sawa na dai la awali {other}.

fail.frequency.en: {count} earlier claims for {service} in {window} days; the limit is {limit}.
fail.frequency.sw: Madai {count} ya awali ya {service} ndani ya siku {window}; kikomo ni {limit}.

R9.name: Clinical consistency
R9.condition: The diagnosis code is consistent with the service billed.
R9.quote: [The Claims Management Office shall] develop formularies to be used to inform benefits packages development, mapping diagnostics, costing and tariff development.
R9.note: SHA's own diagnosis-to-service mapping was not published in the documents. The ICD-10 chapters used here are standard clinical groupings, applied as a warning only.

pass.not_restricted.en: {service} is not tied to a specific diagnosis group.
pass.not_restricted.sw: Huduma {service} haifungamani na kundi maalum la utambuzi.

warn.inconsistent.sw: Utambuzi {icd} kwa kawaida haulingani na huduma {service}.

skip.no_diagnosis.en: Not evaluated: no diagnosis code was given.
skip.no_diagnosis.sw: Haikukaguliwa: hakuna msimbo wa utambuzi uliotolewa.

skip.unknown_service.en: Not evaluated: service {service} is not in the rulebook.
skip.unknown_service.sw: Haikukaguliwa: huduma {service} haipo kwenye kitabu cha kanuni.

R10.name: Timely lodging
R10.condition: The claim is lodged within seven days of the patient's discharge.
R10.quote: A healthcare provider or health facility shall, within seven days from the date of discharge of the patient, lodge a claim to the Claims Management Office.
R10.note: The regulation sets the duty but not the consequence of lateness, so a late claim is flagged as a risk, not as a certain failure. Outpatient visits use the date of service as the discharge date.

pass.on_time.en: Lodged {days} days after discharge, inside the {allowed}-day window.
pass.on_time.sw: Imewasilishwa siku {days} baada ya kuruhusiwa, ndani ya dirisha la siku {allowed}.

warn.late.en: Lodged {days} days after discharge, beyond the {allowed}-day window.
warn.late.sw: Imewasilishwa siku {days} baada ya kuruhusiwa, nje ya dirisha la siku {allowed}.

R11.name: Referral pathway
R11.condition: Social Health Insurance Fund services are purchased on referral from a primary health facility, except in an emergency.
R11.quote: [The Social Health Insurance Fund shall be used to] purchase healthcare services from empanelled and contracted healthcare providers and health facilities on referral from primary health facilities.
R11.note: Regulation 6(3) points to section 27(1) and (2) of the Act for the detail, and the Act was not available. Hakiki checks that a referral reference is present, not that it is valid.

pass.emergency_exempt.en: A referral is not needed for emergency services.
pass.emergency_exempt.sw: Rufaa haihitajiki kwa huduma za dharura.

pass.attached.en: Referral reference attached for the {fund} claim.
pass.attached.sw: Nambari ya rufaa imeambatishwa kwa dai la {fund}.

warn.missing.en: {fund} services are bought on referral from a primary facility, and no referral is attached.
warn.missing.sw: Huduma za {fund} hununuliwa kwa rufaa kutoka kituo cha afya ya msingi, na hakuna rufaa iliyoambatishwa.

attach-referral.en: Attach the referral reference from the primary health facility
attach-referral.sw: Ambatisha nambari ya rufaa kutoka kituo cha afya ya msingi
